definitions.existing_asset: Original media_asset row with provider source_id, excluding the separately reviewed Commons rows.
definitions.technically_reachable: Only rows with a persisted health-check status URL_AVAILABLE/HEALTHY in this audit; UNTESTED is not called reachable.
definitions.valid_film_match: The row is associated with a Work through ingestion identity, but SOURCE_RELATION_UNREVIEWED is not independent artwork confirmation.
definitions.rights_approved: license_verified=true, review_status=APPROVED and health_status=HEALTHY. No institutional source currently meets this gate.
definitions.published: Approved local artwork export; original institutional rows are intentionally zero.

nfb_canada.rights_basis: NFB digital-platform terms state content including photographs/images is protected and non-private reproduction, display, distribution or exploitation requires express written permission; NFB Archives says reproduction/use other than private use requires a written licence.
nfb_canada.technical_notes: The source URL is an NFB CDN jacket/key-art URL. HTTP reachability does not grant a licence. Request an artwork/feed licence and permitted territory/attribution.
nfb_canada.blocker: No item-level permission/licence in the stored metadata; technical access cannot override this.

bfi_player_free.rights_basis: BFI Player terms clauses 2.1–2.4 reserve rights in service content; clauses 6.8 and 6.12 limit use to personal/non-commercial viewing and prohibit copying, displaying, publishing, licensing, scraping, data mining or extraction unless expressly authorized.
bfi_player_free.technical_notes: Image URLs are BFI Player responsive hero-image paths. The internal search endpoint is a technical service, not an artwork feed. No per-file licence, creator or attribution is stored in the ingestion record.
bfi_player_free.blocker: No item-level permission/licence in the stored metadata; technical access cannot override this.

mosfilm.rights_basis: The current www.mosfilm.ru user agreement permits access and reproduction of Materials only for personal, non-commercial use on one computer; it prohibits copying, reproduction, republication, uploading, posting, transmission, distribution or other use without special permission and expressly prohibits use on another website or network environment.
mosfilm.technical_notes: The existing rows resolve to www.mosfilm.ru/upload/iblock/... delivery URLs. The contacts page exposes rights-related contacts, but is not the policy scope. Do not infer rights from film age, official CDN/site reachability or the site promotion language.
mosfilm.blocker: No item-level permission/licence in the stored metadata; technical access cannot override this.

cinematheque_henri.rights_basis: The official legal notice identifies the publisher but grants no blanket image-republication licence. Film collection images can involve archive, photographer and rights-holder permissions.
cinematheque_henri.technical_notes: HENRI thumbnail URLs are 248x186 institutional film images. Preserve as review-only until item-level permission or open licence is recorded.
cinematheque_henri.blocker: No item-level permission/licence in the stored metadata; technical access cannot override this.

retina_latina.rights_basis: Saved ingestion records contain poster URLs but no item-level licence, creator or permission. Availability dates for films are not artwork-reuse permission.
retina_latina.technical_notes: Request a platform artwork licence/feed or item-level permissions; do not confuse viewing rights with image rights.
retina_latina.blocker: No item-level permission/licence in the stored metadata; technical access cannot override this.

35mm_online.rights_basis: Saved records contain image URLs but no item-level reuse licence or attribution. Provider artwork policy was not established from the ingestion snapshot.
35mm_online.technical_notes: Keep all 100 records pending rights/terms confirmation; do not use paid/subscription status as image permission.
35mm_online.blocker: No item-level permission/licence in the stored metadata; technical access cannot override this.

conclusion: Existing institutional image references are plentiful but none have a stored item-level reuse permission or open licence. The exporter is not overly restrictive for this evidence state; publishing them would bypass provider terms. The approved serving increase remains the nine separately reviewed Commons assets, including the DFI-sourced Atlantis poster.
next_action: Obtain written artwork/feed permission or item-level open-licence metadata from NFB, BFI, Mosfilm, HENRI, Retina Latina and 35mm; then run a new immutable provider-scoped artwork observation.
